issues.problem: Repo CSV counter LPIPS 0.193 vs paper 0.176 (and garden/bicycle within 0.003) is not listed among the CSV-vs-paper discrepancies; LPIPS gap on counter may be a metric-package difference.

Zero-importance tie behaviour (many Gaussians with imp==0): projection with thr=0 zeroes nothing, hard prune imp<=0 removes all zero-importance ones, so final count can fall well below (1-r2)N (garden smoke: 189200 vs 199994). Identical to official, so not a bug, but final #G may differ from paper 0.728M if the importance kernel's zero set differs.
issues.fix: Compare admm rows/final N to the paper counts in the benchmark.
